message:
Let me look at the frame header format constants and the `get_header_info` function.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && sed -n '365,470p' blosc/frame.c && echo "===HEADER DEFS===" && grep -n "FRAME_HEADER_MINLEN\|FRAME_HEADER_LEN\|FRAME_LEN\|FRAME_NCHUNKS\|FRAME_CBYTES\|FRAME_NBYTES\|FRAME_CHUNKSIZE\|FRAME_BLOCKSIZE\|FRAME_TYPESIZE\|FRAME_HEADER" blosc/frame.h | head -40</parameter>
